targeted: Per-predicate proof-basis review of the ten MD-S050/MD-S003/MD-S019 bases F-MD-B18-A002-013 moved to INCOMPLETE, now that Admission (E-044) exists for PUBLICATION_EXACT. Audit only: no application or test code is changed by this evidence. For each predicate: read its exact rule_text from the traceability matrix, read the exact production code path its currently-bound positive/negative guard exercises, and independently determine whether the requirement is now genuinely established, partially established with a named residual gap, or blocked on a guard binding that does not exercise the real computation at all.
root_cause_and_implementation: This is a record/review artifact, not an implementation change. Method: (1) confirmed all ten rule_ids against the current STRATEGY_TO_IMPLEMENTATION_TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.csv -- all ten carry coverage_status=NOT_ASSESSED there (a separate, higher-level classification column governed by its own closure process, unaffected by this review) and are recorded as INCOMPLETE in the actual proof-basis registry, docs/market_data/development/implementation/tests/MarketDataReplayVerificationProofBasis.php::INCOMPLETE -- confirmed present there, not PROVEN, by direct grep before any review conclusion was drawn. (2) Read PublicationInputBindingService::deriveCompatibilityHashes() line by line to determine exactly which capture domain backs each of the seven compatibility hashes (identity_revision_set_hash, calendar_revision_set_hash, status_revision_set_hash, event_revision_set_hash, source_scale_assessment_set_hash, market_structure_revision_set_hash, factor_decision_set_hash) Admission's actualBoundInputContext() (E-044) now reads. Finding: identity_revision_set_hash is derived exclusively from the market-structure-consumed-inputs/v1 capture (C11 board/price-band/tick resolution) via deriveMarketStructureBindings(), not from the C02 universe_identity capture (temporal-identity-revisions/v1) MD-S050-R0008/MD-S019-R0067 actually name -- a genuine domain mismatch in E-044's own field mapping, newly discovered by this review and recorded as F-MD-B18-A002-021. calendar_revision_set_hash/status_revision_set_hash are correctly domain-matched (real calendar_session and eligibility-expectation/status captures). event_revision_set_hash/source_scale_assessment_set_hash/factor_decision_set_hash are correctly domain-matched to event/verification/factor-decision content, but PublicationInputBindingService derives no compatibility hash at all for the C09 ancillary/contamination domain (confirmed by an exhaustive grep of the file for ancillary/contamination/dormant -- zero matches), so 'contamination decisions' (one of MD-S050-R0012's four named members) remains unbound regardless of guard binding. (3) Read ProducerRegistrySnapshot::capture() and MarketDataSemanticBindings::snapshot() to determine exactly what the registry_versions component's payload_hash (which E-044 now reads for reason_registry_hash/formula_registry_hash) actually contains: real eod_reason_codes entries, indicator_set_version, coverage_contract_version, and (via semantic_versions) price_product_version -- but no eligibility-version concept anywhere in the system (confirmed by grep across app/), a capture-completeness gap upstream of Admission. read_model_version/serialization_version/executable_build_identity remain live-config-sourced in actualBoundInputContext(), unchanged by E-044 (F-013 did not name these three), even though buildManifestByPublicationId() already exposes a manifest-level read_model_version/build_id E-044 did not read. (4) Read tests/Unit/MarketData/B18ReplayBoundInputIdentityContractTest.php in full -- the positive/negative guard currently bound to eight of the ten predicates (all but MD-S050-R0002/MD-S003-R0003). Finding: both its tests exercise MarketDataEvidenceExportService::exportReplayEvidence() against a hand-constructed md_replay_daily_metrics row with fabricated string values (identities('A')/identities('B'), e.g. 'TEMPORAL_A') -- they prove the evidence exporter passes an already-stored value through without dropping or defaulting it. Neither test calls, mocks, or otherwise exercises ReplayVerificationService::actualBoundInputContext() (the function E-044 actually changed) at all. This is exactly the gap F-013's own review of this same guard originally described ('the guard proves the exporter passes the identities through... does not prove that the identities bind what the contract names') -- unchanged by E-044, because E-044 changed the writer, not this guard, and this guard was never testing the writer. (5) Read tests/Unit/MarketData/B18ReplayComparisonExhaustivenessTest.php in full -- the guard bound to MD-S050-R0002/MD-S003-R0003. This one does exercise the real ReplayVerificationService::verifyRunAgainstFixture()/actualBoundInputContext() path (through a mocked EodPublicationRepository returning a manifest, with the comparison logic itself running unmocked), and its resolvedBoundInputs()/perturbation mechanism is self-calibrating (captures whatever the real computation returns rather than asserting a hardcoded expected value), so it is a materially better-grounded guard than the other eight predicates have. But MD-S050-R0002 requires the full eleven-field conjunction ('using exactly ... frozen with it') and MD-S003-R0003 requires the parallel eleven-item conjunction; both fail on the same residual gaps items (1)-(3) above name, so neither reaches PROVEN despite the stronger guard.
